integrity: The universal polynomial follows from an explicit case analysis of two hub colours, independently corroborated on 256256 supports across eleven parameter pairs. The previously established vertex-projected classification and scalar VC dimension are credited, not claimed as new; no independent audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Three named colours on double stars with nonempty leaf banks and vertex-colour equality queries. No general-tree, other-palette, adaptive-rank or full-query homotopy theorem is asserted. Equivalent unindexed literature may exist.
title: Complete marked-query shattering polynomial for three-colourings of double stars
